instruction: Score the task materials only. Do not infer model performance or task labels. Use ordinal integer scores 0-3 for each dimension and provide one concise rationale per score.

anchors.1: minor ambiguity resolved by normal context

anchors.0: task, code, and exposed checks align
anchors.3: material conflict changes the plausible action

anchors.1: local change with a short consequence chain
anchors.3: nonlocal lifecycle/API interaction or several dependent consequences
all candidates plausible; visible success can hide a hidden-edge failure

output_schema.scores: object mapping all six dimension names to integers 0-3
output_schema.rationales: object mapping the same names to short rationales
